programs.title: The Rare Breed
programs.desc: Western with Maureen O'Hara and James Stewart. With the help of a drifter, a widow strives to fulfil her husband's last wish to introduce rare cattle to the perilous American west.

programs.title: Charlotte Gray
programs.desc: World War II thriller. Cate Blanchett stars as a secret agent sent to occupied France to aid the Resistance against the Nazis. But she has her own agenda. With Michael Gambon.

programs.title: Prey
programs.desc: It's Predator, 1719 style. Amber Midthunder stars as a Comanche hunter who must save her tribe from an extraterrestrial threat in this action prequel. If it bleeds, you can kill it.

programs.title: Renfield
programs.desc: Comedy horror vampire shenanigans with Nicholas Hoult, Awkwafina and a full-blooded Nicolas Cage. Dracula's familiar gets distracted from procuring food for his master.

programs.title: Donkey Punch
programs.desc: Thriller. A group of British teenagers are partying aboard a luxury yacht in the Med when a sexual encounter ends in manslaughter... and provokes a life-or-death fight for survival.

programs.title: Shadow of a Doubt
programs.desc: Hitchcock thriller starring Joseph Cotten as a serial killer fleeing the law. Teresa Wright is his adoring niece who, initially, refuses to believe her uncle is a murderer.

programs.title: The Spoilers
programs.desc: Western. Anne Baxter, Jeff Chandler and Rory Calhoun star in a tale of fortune-seeking and treachery on the untamed Alaskan frontier.

programs.title: The Yellow Mountain
programs.desc: Western. Lex Barker and Howard Duff star as prospectors whose friendship is tested when a promising seam of the gold is discovered in a Nevada mountain. With Mala Powers.

programs.title: Shenandoah
programs.desc: Western. James Stewart stars as a wealthy Virginia farming patriarch trying to keep his family together and safe in the midst of the encroaching American Civil War.

programs.title: Our Friend
programs.desc: Dakota Johnson, Jason Segel and Casey Affleck in Gabriela Cowperthwaite's poignant drama about a family coping with a terminal cancer diagnosis, and the friend who moves in to help.
